Comment: Potential use of fuel cells.
Response: HUD has followed development of fuel cell research, but believes that this development has not reached the stage justifying a BREAKTHROUGH type demonstration.
Additional Response: Assistant Secretary Finger responded directly to the Federal Power Commission letter in detail; a copy of that letter is attached to the incoming letter in the Appendix.
I. Department of Housing and Urban Development
Comments were received from the General Counsel, Federal Insurance Administrator, Assistant Secretaries for Equal Opportunity, Community Planning and Management and Administration, and the Regional Administrators, Regions IV and IX. These comments have been incorporated as appropriate in the Final Statement.
8. RECOMMENDED HUD ACTION
Operation BREAKTHROUGH was initiated in May, 1969, and ground was broken on all sites in 1970. This Environmental Statement is therefore prepared as a record of the environmental considerations which governed the program development, much of which produced the establishment of current regulations. It is believed that this Final Statement demonstrates that Operation BREAKTHROUGH has met the intent of these regulations and has been responsive to those factors presented in the comments from the various Federal Agencies. The Department expresses its appreciation to those Agencies which submitted comments and suggestions for future research activities.
